what.text: This page follows refugees from Honduras living in Spain, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 2586 Honduran refugees in Spain, 2.7% of all refugees from Honduras.
Mexico hosts the most Honduran refugees, followed by the United States, Spain and the United Kingdom.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Honduras, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2021 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2001 at 5 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Spain.
These are year-end totals for Spain only, reported to UNHCR.
